title: {{name}} and the Moon Rocket
text: {{name}} looks up at the night sky. There are many stars. {{name}} sees a big rocket. It is going to the moon. {{name}} wants to go too. A kind robot waves to {{name}}. It is sitting in the rocket. {{name}} climbs in fast. The rocket is going up now. There are stars all around them. The moon is getting close. {{name}} sees grey rocks. {{name}} is jumping high and slow. The robot is laughing with {{name}}. They look back at Earth. It is a blue ball. It is far away. {{name}} feels very happy. {{name}} is brave and curious. The robot gives {{name}} a small star. {{name}} keeps it in one hand. Now they fly home together.

glossary.zh: 火箭(飞向太空的交通工具)

questions.prompt: Who is with {{name}} in the rocket?
